description: One email a sending tool actually sent to one lead: what a pipeline finds and traverses from to reach the person it went to (instantly/lead), never the target of a deliver step. Keyed on the lead's address plus the send time, since a sent email has no platform-public URL and a vendor's message id is never a tier (SPEC.md §4). Seeded by instantly/sent-emails.

fields.name: lead_email
fields.description: The address the email was sent to. First component of the key; a lead gets each send once.

fields.name: sent_at
fields.description: When the email left, RFC3339 as the vendor reports it. Second component of the key, so the emails of one sequence to one lead stay separate records.

fields.name: step
fields.description: The sequence position as the vendor labels it. Instantly writes <sequence>_<step>_<variant>, so the first email is 0_0_0; a pipeline filters first touches on the 0_0_ prefix.

fields.name: message_id
fields.description: The RFC 5322 Message-ID the email carried, angle brackets included, for matching replies and threads.
